appReviewNotesEn: This release offers all themes free of charge to users who start during the launch campaign, without expiry and without requiring a rating or feedback. Existing purchases remain valid. A future release may close enrollment for new users while preserving earlier grants. Ratings use the Apple native StoreReview API only, after a study interaction; the OS controls presentation. A separate optional feedback invitation opens an editable system email composer. It does not filter users by sentiment, require a rating, or send mail automatically. Current purchase entry points are suppressed for free users; access/purchase restoration remains available.
